summary: For any nonzero a, independent cap-one uniforms X,Y with the allowed quadratic shift H(Y)=Y^2/a give aX^2+2XY+H(Y)=a(X+Y/a)^2 and infinite H_(1/2) at zero. Therefore the curvature-robust one-star half-Riesz theorem cannot be extended across arbitrary nonzero physical self-curvature without spending additional spectral/product structure. This rank-one mechanism is not a QFORM counterexample.
